_provenance.title: TG-43U1S2 consensus dataset for the IsoRay Medical model CS-1 Rev2 (Proxcelan) 131Cs source, as embedded in Paper 1's dose engine
_provenance.copied_from: GammaTile.py (GammaView Dosimetry 3D Slicer module, github.com/Peelyboneheader/GammaTileDosimetry), class DoseInterpolator lines 26-264, dataset 'TG43U1S2'; clone commit ac47ad6beaace273b13dc911e592dec4f153bdc0 (2026-11-02)
_provenance.extraction: class block sliced with ast and executed with numpy only; values written verbatim as Python floats; untabulated entries (numpy NaN) written as null
_provenance.paper: Rivard MJ et al., Supplement 2 for the 2004 update of the AAPM Task Group No. 43 Report: Joint recommendations by the AAPM and GEC-ESTRO. Med Phys 44(9):e297-e338 (2017). doi:10.1002/mp.12430

tables_as_stated_in_source_comments.g_L: Table AII, line-source column 'IsoRay CS-1 Rev2'
tables_as_stated_in_source_comments.F: Table AXIII; the theta = 90 deg row (F = 1 by definition) is added by Paper 1 and is not printed in the report; r = 0.1 cm is not tabulated for theta <= 20 deg
tables_as_stated_in_source_comments.half_life: Table XXIV: T1/2 = 9.689 d; Paper 1 stores the mean life tau = 335.48 h

_provenance.erratum_applied: Not stated for the consensus tables in Paper 1's source; the 2018 erratum (Rivard MJ et al., Erratum: Supplement 2 for the 2004 update of the AAPM Task Group No. 43 Report. Med Phys 45(2):971-974 (2018). doi:10.1002/mp.12728) corrects the report's QA dose-rate tables, not Tables AI/AII/AXIII. Paper 1's QA script states that its Table XII values ARE the erratum-corrected ones (see tg43u1s2_table_xii_erratum.csv).
_provenance.independent_verification: The journal pages (Wiley) return HTTP 403. A free PDF of the 2017 report hosted by IROC Houston (irochouston.mdanderson.org/RPc/BrachySeeds/TG-43-Supplement-2.pdf) was text-extracted (pypdf) and Tables AI, AII and AXIII were compared entry by entry with this file and with gtcore's tables (docs/paper2-phase-notes.md, Phase 3 engine QA): gtcore matches the report everywhere; this file (Paper 1) differs from the report at ONE entry, F(r = 7 cm, theta = 80 deg) = 0.999 where the report prints 0.998. That entry is kept here as Paper 1 has it -- this file documents Paper 1's engine.
_provenance.generated_by: python scripts/engine_crosscheck.py --paper1 <GammaTileDosimetry clone> --write-fixtures --table-xxiii-text <pypdf text of the IROC-hosted report PDF> --points-out <per-point grid csv>

source_model: IsoRay Medical / GT Medical Technologies model CS-1 Rev2 (Proxcelan)

g_L.paper1_interpolation: linear in r (numpy.interp); held constant below 0.10 cm and above 10 cm

F.paper1_interpolation: bilinear in (r, theta) on the adjacent nodes, clamped to the table domain; untabulated entries filled from the nearest tabulated radius at the same theta, searching outward first

phi_an_note: The 1-D anisotropy factor phi_an(r) (TG-43U1S2 Table AXIV) is embedded in neither Paper 1's engine nor gtcore: both are 2-D line-source only (no 1-D mode by decision). Nothing to compare; not transcribed here to avoid an unverifiable hand copy.
